spl_product_data_elements: Instant Hand Sanitizer Ethyl Alcohol WATER GLYCERIN ALOE VERA LEAF .ALPHA.-TOCOPHEROL ACETATE FD&C BLUE NO. 1 FD&C YELLOW NO. 5 ALCOHOL ALCOHOL
purpose: XtraCare Instant Hand Sanitizer - Original Kills 99.9% of Germs with Moisturizers & Vitamin E
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
indications_and_usage: USE: hand sanitizer to help reduce bacteria on the skin that may cause disease
warnings: Warnings: for external use only. Flammable. Keep away from heat and flame. Do not use in the eyes. In case of contact, rinse eyes thoroughly with water. Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation and redness develop and persist for more than 72 hours.
dosage_and_administration: Directions: wet hands thoroughly with product briskly rub hands together until dry children under 6 years of age should be supervised by an adult when using.
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients: carbomer, glycerin, propylene glycol, tocopheryl acetate (vitamin E), triethanolamine, water, fragrance.
